releaseNotes:
_Date: 2026-06-25_

---

### ✨ What's New

#### 🧰 Managed MCP Server Gallery
Compass Partner now gives organisations stronger control over managed MCP server rollout:

- **Org-provided MCP servers** can appear in a managed gallery for easier discovery and setup.
- **Google Analytics** is available as a new MCP gallery entry.
- **Managed MCP configuration examples** were added to support IT/admin deployment workflows.
- **Valid managed MCP entries are preserved** when configuration is sanitized, avoiding accidental removal of usable server definitions.

#### 🗂 Global Storage for Agent Files
Agent-generated files are now easier to find and reuse:

- A new **global Storage page** centralizes files created by agents.
- Storage previews were improved for a cleaner file-review experience.
- Storage page copy is now localized.

#### 💬 Richer Chat Rendering
Chat output and prompts now support more faithful formatting:

- Markdown images can be shown in chat.
- User prompts render markdown instead of plain text only.
- Streaming responses are smoother and line breaks are preserved more reliably.
- An **AI reminder** is now shown in chat to set clearer expectations.

---

### 🛠️ Improvements

- **Desktop performance** — reduced idle work to keep the app lighter when not actively in use.
- **macOS branding** — the Dock icon is now set explicitly, and generated icons were realigned.
- **Compass platform access** — added a direct Compass platform link in the renderer.
- **Enterprise deployment guidance** — added an IT deployment guide and hardened uninstall data-preservation defaults.
- **ACP recaps** — surfaced recap metadata and buffered recap output until the app is idle.
- **Workflow authoring guidance** — workflow docs now prefer manifest-based file maps.
- **Code quality** — consolidated JSON parsing and improved tool-call deduplication.

---

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Auto-update policy** now respects managed configuration instead of ignoring IT-controlled update settings.
- **Chat actions and rendering** fixes include disabling **Clear chat** when history is empty, remeasuring virtualized groups, and improving Obsidian/dynamic tool labels.
- **Preview security** now uses safe image data URLs.
- **Workflow tool use** is hardened to prevent invented tools.
- **MCP gallery UI** hides irrelevant local-install notes where they do not apply.
- **Build configuration** now places `externalizeDeps` where electron-vite reads it and splits heavy modules for more reliable packaging.

---

### ⚙️ Under the Hood

- Upgraded to **Vite 8 with the Rolldown bundler**.
- Overrode **esbuild to 0.28.1+** to address the dev-server request-forwarding advisory GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99.
- Removed the deprecated WhatsApp feature code.
- Bumped application version metadata to **1.0.12**.

_Co-authored by [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/portfolio/nova.html)_
